exceptions.rationale: INV-1030 matches INV-1029 on customer C-027, invoice date 2025-04-06, and the line for 243 shelving units totaling $31,172.04. Only INV-1029 has a supporting bill of lading and deposit.
No bill of lading or bank statement entry references INV-1030.
The invoice is dated 2025-12-30, but the bill of lading shows all 246 units shipped on 2026-01-03, after year-end. The shipment does not support FY2025 recognition.
